mapper.select: SELECT id AS version,user_app_id AS userAppId,merchant_app_id AS merchantAppId,rider_app_id AS riderAppId, merchant_no AS merchantNo,serial_no AS serialNo,public_key_id AS publicKeyId,payment_callback AS paymentCallback, refund_callback AS refundCallback,transfer_callback AS transferCallback,(user_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AS userSecretSet, (merchant_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AS merchantSecretSet,(rider_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AS riderSecretSet, (api_v3_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AS apiV3KeySet,(merchant_private_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AS merchantPrivateKeySet, (wechat_public_secret_id IS NOT NULL) AS wechatPublicKeySet,payment_enabled AS enabled, operator,created_at AS createdAt FROM wechat_config ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT actor,action_name AS actionName,target_id AS targetId,before_state AS beforeState, after_state AS afterState,reason,created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_audit_log WHERE action_name LIKE 'wechat.%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
